_note: Statement-level authority classification, bijective with normative-inventory.json (one row per stmt_id). disposition in {corpus-backed, pack-local-extension, orchestration-only}. corpus-backed rows carry canonical corpus_ids; pack-local-extension rows carry ext_id + relation + nearest_corpus_ids + why_no_conflict (authority strictly below corpus).

rows.statement: §0 Classify the surface (MARKETING/APP/HYBRID/out-of-scope) before generating
§0 A governing design contract outranks these defaults; consume via design-review-gate
Ban default indigo/violet accents (#6366f1 #4f46e5 #8b5cf6 #7c3aed) and the beige/brass/espresso + olive/clay/terracotta unresearched families; no even-distribution/decorative-semantic color
rows.why_no_conflict: adds specific banned hex families/palettes; ANTISLOP-2001's strength/override untouched

rows.statement: §1 em-dash: zero em-dashes in generated page copy
Ban Fraunces/Instrument Serif as unjustified display defaults, the decorative one-word swap, all-caps/small labels without letter-spacing, clipped italic descenders
rows.why_no_conflict: adds specific font/typographic ban signatures; no corpus rule altered

rows.statement: Ban card-as-default grouping, decorative left accent stripe, 3-col icon-in-circle grid, split-header default, double hairline table borders, emoji-as-iconography
rows.why_no_conflict: adds specific container ban signatures; no corpus rule altered

rows.statement: §1 eyebrow labels are capped (concept)

Eyebrow cap = at most 1 per 3 sections (exact count); ban section numbering, version stamps, pagination on tiles, locale/weather strips, scroll cues, poetic/step labels, middle-dot chains (max one · per line)
rows.why_no_conflict: eyebrow cap (<=1 per 3 sections) is tighter than the ANTISLOP-2001/2004 eyebrow concept; other meta-tells are orthogonal additions; a tighter bound cannot weaken

rows.statement: Ban div-built fake product UI, placeholder people/testimonials/logos/metrics, CSS-blob fake imagery; design the empty/honest slot instead
rows.why_no_conflict: adds fake-content bans not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: Light is baseline (dark only if briefed); no calm-editorial autopilot without a written reason
rows.why_no_conflict: adds light-baseline / calm-editorial guardrails not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: Hero <=2 lines / <=20 words / <=4 text elements / CTA above fold / top padding ~6rem; nav single-line <=80px; each layout family at most once/page; zigzag run <=2; bento cells == content with >=2-3 varied; per-section mobile collapse declared
rows.why_no_conflict: exact marketing layout budgets not modelled in corpus; adds constraints only

rows.statement: Hierarchy 3-4 levels by weight/spacing not size; micro text (<=11px) whitelisted to an enumerated role list
rows.why_no_conflict: exact hierarchy/micro-text bounds not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: At most 2 visible accent uses per screen; one theme/accent/radius lock per page
rows.why_no_conflict: exact accent-count budget not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: §3 contrast floors WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large; non-text 3:1)
Focus and state indicators treated as ALWAYS in scope for non-text contrast (a deliberately stricter pack floor); placeholder + over-image/scrim text included; dark-mode secondary text 4.5:1
rows.why_no_conflict: treats focus/state indicators as always in-scope, tighter than WCAG AA (COLOR-1010/A11Y-1020); a stricter contrast floor cannot weaken the corpus rule

rows.statement: Every data surface renders Loading/Empty/Error/Populated/Edge; explicit edge matrix (10k rows, 200-char strings, missing fields, 0-results, offline mid-submit)
rows.why_no_conflict: the five-state + edge matrix is a production requirement not modelled as corpus rules

rows.statement: §5 touch targets 44x44pt iOS / 48x48dp Android minimum (pointer-only exception)
Modal scrim visibly isolates foreground (~32%-black default); press/hover states never shift layout; every supported color mode rendered
rows.why_no_conflict: scrim/press-state/color-mode floors not modelled in corpus (touch-target itself is corpus-backed elsewhere)

rows.statement: On restyle, never silently change URL slugs/anchor IDs, nav labels, form field names/order, logo/wordmark, legal/consent copy; extract existing brand colors first; never regress existing a11y
rows.why_no_conflict: a restyle workflow preservation constraint; not a corpus semantic rule

rows.statement: §7 The pre-flight gate — a mechanical checklist that re-checks the statements above
When-NOT routing; Provenance

Per-surface ms budget table (hover 90-160 … route 240-500); standard <300ms, nothing >500ms; exit = 65-75% of entrance; distance scales duration; frequency scales duration down; never animate keyboard-initiated actions
rows.why_no_conflict: Kowalski-sourced numeric ms budgets; corpus MOTION rules are conceptual and carry no such numbers

rows.statement: Enter ease-out / exit ease-in / move ease-in-out / mechanical linear; named bezier defaults (M3 standard/emphasized, CSS ease)
rows.why_no_conflict: specific easing curves/bezier values not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: §2 easing — refusing mislabelled bezier values (M2-as-M3, CSS-ease-as-Apple) is citation hygiene

Critical-damping formula damping=2*sqrt(stiffness); preset table; momentum projection (Apple exponential-decay d~=0.998); rubber-band (c=0.55); velocity handoff w/ zero-guard; momentum dismissal velocity OR distance (~0.11 px/ms)
rows.why_no_conflict: physics formulas/coefficients; implementation guidance not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: Stagger 30-80ms, sequence <500ms, non-blocking; one element leads; overshoot budgets (success 5-10%/celebration <=25%/errors 0%); asymmetric deliberate/response timing
rows.why_no_conflict: exact choreography budgets not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: §5 animate transform/opacity, not layout-triggering properties (concept)

transition:all banned; Framer x/y/scale main-thread caveat; inheriting CSS-var recalc; interruptible/retarget; never scale(0) (enter 0.9-0.97); transform-origin from trigger; gate hover behind (hover:hover)
rows.why_no_conflict: implementation performance constraints; not modelled in corpus

rows.statement: §6 reduced motion is a floor; every animation ships a prefers-reduced-motion variant; motion never the only signal
'fewer and gentler, not zero' mapping (slide+fade->fade, spring->tween, parallax->removed)
rows.why_no_conflict: elaborates the corpus reduced-motion floor (MOTION-1009/A11Y-2001) with a specific reduction mapping; adds detail, never weakens

rows.statement: §7 Misquoted research — do-not-cite-wrong corrections (citation hygiene, no corpus counterpart)
§8 Pre-ship gate — severity-tiered mechanical checklist
When-NOT routing; Provenance
§1 Measure before judging — font/touch/color census snippets (review method; referenced VALUES belong to ui-design-craft/corpus)
§2 The passes, in order (contract/static/states/motion/flow/consistency) — review procedure
§3 Findings + bounded fix loop + three-valued verdict (Block/Changes required/Approve) — review procedure
§4 The design contract — classification/verification/drift-direction/anti-impersonation/authoring (contract mechanics)
§5 Reviewing generated variants — anti-convergence + preference hygiene (review procedure)
When-NOT routing; Provenance
